name: Economy of the Elysian Concord
summary: Currency, the Monetary Authority, narrow banking, taxation, public finance and the zero discount rate, fiscal equalization, ownership forms, capital markets, labour, and the Civic Income.

units.currency: dram; values in whole dram unless stated
units.workingTime: civil hours (1 civil hour = 3,586.15 SI seconds)

currency.name: The dram
currency.summary: Currency of the Concord; symbol d, divided into 100 minims. Named from a Thalassic trade weight of the Long Reach because it belonged to no region's imperial past.
currency.physicalCurrencyRationale: Redundancy applied to money: it works when the network does not, leaves no record, and is usable by anyone. The cost is an insurance premium, not a subsidy.

monetaryAuthority.name: The Concord Monetary Authority
monetaryAuthority.summary: Issues currency and sets monetary policy under a three-limb mandate with no fixed priority; must publish which limb it prioritised and why.
monetaryAuthority.contested: Critics argue an unordered mandate is no mandate. The Concord's answer is that a single-target central bank hides the tradeoff rather than resolving it, and a published tradeoff is more accountable than a concealed one. Unsettled.

banking.origin: A response to the Integration's financial collapses, in which the failure of lending institutions destroyed the payment system ordinary people depended on and forced rescues the founders called the socialisation of a gamble already lost.
banking.acknowledgedCost: Credit is scarcer and dearer than under fractional banking. Firms complain constantly; a substantial minority of Concord economists agree the complaint is correct.

taxes.name: Income tax
taxes.summary: Progressive; the largest single revenue source.

taxes.name: Land value tax
taxes.summary: Largest regional tax; follows from the stewardship obligation, under which land is held subject to duties and cannot be degraded.

taxes.name: Wealth transfer tax
taxes.summary: Levied on the recipient's lifetime cumulative receipts, steeply progressive above a generous threshold; top band 71%. Heavy because four living generations and 112-year lifespans would otherwise compound dynastic fortunes across overlapping lifetimes.

taxes.name: Constrained List extraction levy
taxes.summary: Rises automatically as a material's reserve horizon shortens. Not a revenue measure in intent but the price signal that funds substitution research and makes recycling profitable; largely responsible for recovery rates above 90%.

discountRate.rationale: Elysians treat discounting future welfare simply because it is future as a moral error, not merely an economic assumption.
discountRate.consequences: A sea wall protecting a city in 300 years is appraised at close to full value. The fusion transition, the 122-year CO2 decline, and the Veydran research commons would all have failed a conventional discounted test.
discountRate.acknowledgedCost: Almost everything clears the bar, so the binding constraint becomes real resources and administrative capacity, and prioritisation shifts from analysis to politics.

fiscalEqualization.basis: fiscal capacity measured by taxable base, not actual revenue, so a Region cannot gain by taxing itself lightly
fiscalEqualization.canonNote: Equalization narrows the gap substantially and does not close it, and the Concord has never agreed whether closing it would be desirable.

ownershipForms.name: Worker cooperatives
ownershipForms.summary: Owned by their workers, one member one vote. Not mandated — their prevalence follows from equal-terms public risk capital, the wealth transfer tax making worker sale cheaper than bequest, and conversion tax deferral.

ownershipForms.name: Public enterprises
ownershipForms.summary: Publicly owned, commercially operated, at every tier.

ownershipForms.name: Stewardship foundations
ownershipForms.summary: Equity held by a purpose-bound trust with no distributable owner; concentrated in long-horizon industries where a hundred-year commitment is the product.

enterprise.bankruptcyRationale: A society that punishes failure gets less attempt.
enterprise.lossRateRationale: A public risk fund with a low loss rate is not taking risk.

longFormDisclosureRequires: materials use against the Constrained List

fallowEntitlement.name: The fallow entitlement
fallowEntitlement.summary: Up to one Elysian year away from work, job protected, paid at 45%, accrued once every twelve years of employment.
fallowEntitlement.rationale: A person who will work for sixty years should not spend all sixty working continuously, and a civilization designed to last centuries should not treat a life as an uninterrupted input.

civicIncome.name: The Civic Income
civicIncome.summary: Unconditional cash payment delivering Charter right 11; paid to every resident adult and to the guardian of every child, never withdrawn as income rises.
civicIncome.designNote: A basic income that must buy healthcare is a healthcare cut. Healthcare, education, and housing are guaranteed separately.
civicIncome.unresolvedArgument: Whether the Civic Income suppresses bottom-end wages by subsidising low-paying employers. Sectoral bargaining pushes the other way and the effects are hard to separate. Canon records this as unsettled.

knownWeaknesses.name: Credit scarcity
knownWeaknesses.summary: Narrow banking makes credit dearer; a substantial minority of economists agree with the complaint.

knownWeaknesses.name: Unordered monetary mandate
knownWeaknesses.summary: Three limbs with no priority grants the Board discretion critics say a democracy should not delegate.

knownWeaknesses.name: Appraisal permissiveness
knownWeaknesses.summary: A zero pure time preference lets almost everything clear the bar, shifting prioritisation from analysis to politics.

knownWeaknesses.name: Equalization is a standing grievance
knownWeaknesses.summary: Renegotiated every eight years; neither contributors nor recipients regard the settlement as legitimate.

knownWeaknesses.name: Wealth transfer avoidance
knownWeaknesses.summary: Long lifespans give enormous time to structure transfers; yield has drifted down for sixty years despite unchanged rates.

knownWeaknesses.name: Regional debt divergence
knownWeaknesses.summary: Regional debt ranges from 4% to 61% of output with no planetary limit and no agreed answer if a Region cannot pay.

knownWeaknesses.name: The wage-suppression question
knownWeaknesses.summary: Whether the Civic Income subsidises low-paying employers is unresolved after two centuries of data.

knownWeaknesses.name: Cooperative growth ceiling
knownWeaknesses.summary: Worker cooperatives are stable and productive but raise capital less easily; the sector's share has not grown in ninety years.

knownWeaknesses.name: Fallow inequality
knownWeaknesses.summary: Take-up is 79% among high earners and 41% among low earners, so an entitlement for everyone is used most by those who need it least.

knownWeaknesses.name: Sectoral bargaining rigidity
knownWeaknesses.summary: Sector-wide agreements protect incumbents and can slow entry by firms with genuinely different models.

knownWeaknesses.name: Working-time politics
knownWeaknesses.summary: The time-versus-income argument is permanent and neither side can win it, so the settlement drifts rather than being decided.

knownWeaknesses.name: Long-horizon capital is thin outside foundations
knownWeaknesses.summary: Ordinary firms still face investors with shorter horizons than the Concord's own appraisal rules.
